sections.heading: Who we are
body: Prendete is a free app for organizing events and date polls among friends. For any question about your data, write to us at support@prendete.ar.

sections.heading: What data we collect
body: Your account details: first name, last name, email and password. The password is stored only as a hash, never in plain text.

If you sign in with Google, we receive your name, verified email and profile photo from Google. We don't receive or store your Google password, and we use that information only to sign you in and create your profile.
Your profile photo, if you choose to upload one.
What you create or do in the app: events, date polls, votes, attendance and comments.
Your preferred language and, if you enable notifications, the technical push subscription data of your browser.

sections.heading: What we use it for
body: To run the app, show your name and photo to people taking part in the same events or polls as you, send you account verification and password recovery emails, and send you notifications about your events if you turned them on.
We don't sell your data or use it for advertising.

sections.heading: Who we share it with
body: People taking part in the same event or poll can see your name and photo.

We use providers to run the service: Render (app hosting), Neon (database), Cloudflare (DNS), Brevo (email delivery) and Google (sign-in and location search through Google Maps). Push notifications are delivered through your browser's service (Google, Apple or Mozilla). These providers process data only to provide their service to us.

sections.heading: Data stored in your browser
body: We store a session token and your preferences (such as language) in your browser. We don't use tracking cookies or analytics tools.

sections.heading: Retention and your rights
body: We keep your data while you have an account. You can delete your account at any time from your profile ("Delete my account"): your data, the events and polls you organized, and your attendance and votes are erased. We keep encrypted backups for 14 days, so the data of a deleted account may remain in them until that period ends. You can also ask us for access, correction or deletion of your data by writing to support@prendete.ar. Under Argentina's Personal Data Protection Law 25.326, you have the right to access, rectify and delete your data; the Agency for Access to Public Information is the supervisory authority under that law.

sections.heading: Security
body: We use encrypted connections (HTTPS) and store passwords as hashes. No system is completely infallible, but we work to protect your information.

sections.heading: Changes to this policy
body: We may update this policy. The date of the last update is shown at the top of this page.

sections.heading: Acceptance
body: By creating an account or using Prendete you accept these terms. If you don't agree, don't use the app.

sections.heading: What Prendete is
body: Prendete is a free tool for organizing events and date polls among people who know each other. We don't organize the events or take part in them.

sections.heading: Your account
body: You must give us truthful information and keep your account access safe. You're responsible for what is done with your account.

sections.heading: Acceptable use
body: You may not use Prendete for illegal activities, to harass or deceive other people, to send spam, or to try to break or overload the service.

sections.heading: Your content
body: You're responsible for the events, polls, comments and photos you post. We may remove content or suspend accounts that break these terms.

sections.heading: Service availability
body: We provide Prendete as is, free of charge. It may have interruptions or changes, and we don't guarantee it will always be available or error-free.

sections.heading: Liability
body: To the extent permitted by law, we aren't responsible for what happens at events organized through the app, or for losses resulting from using or being unable to use the service.

sections.heading: Changes
body: We may change these terms. If you keep using the app after a change, you're taken to accept it.

sections.heading: Contact and governing law
body: You can write to us at support@prendete.ar. These terms are governed by the laws of the Argentine Republic.
